title: Hearty Venezuelan Plantains Grill
description: A flavorful and comforting dish featuring sweet plantains, nutella, and the rich char of a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch thick rounds.
In a small bowl, mix together the cumin, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the coconut oil onto both sides of the plantain slices, then sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Place the plantain slices on the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they develop a nice char.
While the plantains are cooking, melt the nutella in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the plantains are done, serve them hot with the melted nutella drizzled over the top and garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
